# Requirements Quality Checklist: Push Manager Check

**Purpose**: Review whether the spec and plan for the README comment change are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable (standard depth, PR reviewer audience).
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK001 Is "comment" defined precisely enough (hidden HTML comment vs. other markup) to avoid misinterpretation? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK002 Is "briefly identify its purpose" given a concrete bound (e.g., wording keywords or length)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK003 Is "README" unambiguous as the root `README.md` rather than any other README file? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK004 Is "end of the README" defined for files with or without a trailing newline? [Gap, Plan §Structure Decision] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK005 Do FR-001 (exactly one new line) and FR-003 (no other line modified) stay consistent if the file lacks a trailing newline? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK006 Is FR-004 (only README changes) consistent with the spec artifacts and checklist files added on the branch? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK007 Does the "no duplicate line" edge case align with the "exactly one added line" criterion when the comment already exists? [Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases, §SC-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK008 Can "visually identical when rendered" be objectively measured, and is the reference renderer named? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK009 Is the baseline for the diff (main branch) stated consistently across SC-001 and the acceptance scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK010 Is "without any manual intervention" defined in terms of which pipeline steps it covers? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK011 Is each functional requirement traceable to at least one success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001–FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Edge Case & Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for a README whose last line is inside a list, code block, or other structure? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK013 Are requirements specified for what happens if the pipeline step (push or PR) fails? [Gap, Exception Flow] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK014 Is it stated whether a rerun of the pipeline should be idempotent? [Gap, Recovery] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK015 Is the assumption that GitHub-style renderers hide HTML comments documented as validated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK016 Is the dependency on the existing test suite passing unchanged scoped to a named command? [Dependency, Spec §FR-005, Plan §Technical Context] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
